'''Plastisheet'''<ref name="BS">''[[MedStar I: Battle Surgeons]]''</ref> or '''plastisheet'''<ref name="Ringers">{{JournalCite|6|Ringers (short story)}}</ref> was a type of material. It could be used to write down records on and for data storage purposes.<ref name="BS" /> [[Corporal/Legends|Corporal]] [[Valon Rizz]] used a plastsheet to protect the [[Water/Legends|water]] garden full of [[Lily/Legends|lillies]] on his desk.<ref name="Ringers" />
